title: Professional cultivation courses
intro: Structured cultivation learning paths built from researched instruction, guided practice, job tasks, course tests, and applied practical work. Use Learn for the broad education library; use Courses when you want a sequenced learning path.

courses.title: Safety, Responsible Practice & Cultivation Workflows
courses.summary: Build the workplace decision habits expected of a cultivation technician: hazard recognition, biosecurity, controlled instructions, traceability, equipment boundaries, trustworthy records, and professional shift handoff.

learningSurfaces.title: Learn
learningSurfaces.copy: The broad plant-science and cultivation reference library for topic-first study.

learningSurfaces.title: Courses
learningSurfaces.copy: Sequenced instruction with lessons, practice, workbook tasks, and learning assessments.

learningSurfaces.title: Certification
learningSurfaces.copy: A separate credential-governance and secure assessment layer. Course tests do not themselves issue a professional credential.

courseFlow.title: Orient
courseFlow.copy: See the objective, relevance, prerequisites, and position in the course.

courseFlow.title: Learn
courseFlow.copy: Work through researched explanations, examples, and teaching visuals.

courseFlow.title: Practice
courseFlow.copy: Use cases, retrieval checks, workbook tasks, and practical decisions.

courseFlow.title: Assess
courseFlow.copy: Complete module tests and the final course test before progressing.

assessmentNote: Course tests are learning assessments. They are separate from the secure professional certification examination.

editingPolicy.note: The renderer iterates content arrays and does not impose a fixed course-count limit.
